title: Building a private inner voice inside an AI RPG: a Zanpakutō spirit with its own perspective
author: yrovex
selftext:
I’m the developer of SOUL RP, a Bleach-inspired AI roleplay RPG. This is a 70-second demo of the weapon-spirit feature, Soul Behind the Blade.



The design challenge here is using generative roleplay for a character who shares your history without becoming an always-agreeable hint dispenser. The demo separates the ongoing scene from a private question to your Zanpakutō spirit. There is also an inner world and a spirit with its own temperament, form, and voice. In the shown exchange, the spirit interprets the player’s situation with Rukia rather than simply listing the next action to take.



That separation is the part I’d like to discuss: when an AI character can comment privately on a scene, how do you keep it useful while preserving uncertainty and the character’s own point of view? Would you prefer a spirit that challenges your reasoning, recalls shared experiences, or occasionally refuses to give advice?



I’d welcome feedback on the interaction shown in the demo. Project for context: [https://yrovex.com/soulrp/](https://yrovex.com/soulrp/)
